description: This is a Java integration test class for the IndexInitializer component, testing MongoDB index initialization behavior in various scenarios.

classes.name: IndexInitializerIT
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying MongoDB index initialization behavior.

methods.name: startMongoResource
methods.description: Starts a MongoDB resource before all tests run.

methods.name: stopMongoResource
methods.description: Stops the MongoDB resource after all tests have run.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up the testing environment before each test, including actor system, materializer, and database.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleans up resources after each test, shutting down actor system and cleaning database.

methods.name: initializeSucceedsWhenNoIndicesExistYet
methods.description: Test: index initialization succeeds when no indices are present.

methods.name: initializeSucceedsWhenNoIndicesAreDefined
methods.description: Test: index initialization succeeds when no indices are defined.

methods.name: initializeSucceedsWhenIndexWithDifferentIndexOrderIsCreated
methods.description: Test: index re-initialization with different order updates indices accordingly.

methods.name: initializeSucceedsWhenIndexWithAdditionalFieldIsCreated
methods.description: Test: index initialization adds additional fields to existing indices.

methods.name: initializeIgnoresIndexCreateWhenConflictingIndexWithSameUniqueAlreadyExists
methods.description: Test: conflicting unique index with same name is ignored.

methods.name: initializeFailsWhenConflictingIndexWithSameNameAlreadyExists
methods.description: Test: conflicting index with same name causes failure.

methods.name: initializeSucceedsWhenNoConflictingIndicesExist
methods.description: Test: initialization when no conflicting indices exist.

methods.name: initializeDeletesUndefinedIndices
methods.description: Test: undefined indices are deleted during re-initialization.

methods.description: Creates specified indices on a collection.

methods.name: assertIndices
methods.description: Asserts that the collection has the expected indices.
